Dialogs.Dialog: Your battery's gonna die？ Here, time to charge it.
You're not supposed to ask about that. Penalty! No treats for you! Hehe.
No way. If you're a good boy, I'll think about it.
Don't be in such a rush. Hehe.
Want a goodbye kiss？ Hehe, do your best today.
▲主人公＊▲, have a good day. Come home early, okay？
You're forgetting something？ ...Here, *mwah*. Have a good day.▼
Welcome home, ▲主人公＊▲. You must be tired, right？ Get some rest.
Welcome home, ▲主人公＊▲. Did you have a good day？
Welcome home, ▲主人公＊▲. Bath？ Dinner？ Or maybe... Hehehe!
Here. Make sure to chew properly and eat slowly？
Hehe, looks so good. I want some too.▼
I'd love to make you something next time.
You really make it look delicious, huh？ Hehe, so cute.▼
There. Do your best with cleaning up, too!
Let's brush our teeth after resting a bit.
There you go. Was it good？
Good night. Make sure you don't sleep in tomorrow？
I won't let you sleep, you know？ ...Hehe, just kidding. Good night.
Not until you give me a goodnight kiss？ Hehe.
Has anything caught your interest lately？
Uh-huh. Maybe I'll take a look sometime. Sounds fun.
Nothing？ Hmm... Then why don't you do something with your big sister？
Is that so？ Yeah, I guess that works too, right？
What kind of music do you like these days？
Ah, you're copying me, aren't you？ Hehe.
Actually, me too. Hehe, we match.
Wanna listen to my recommendations？ Hope you like them.
What kind of TV shows are you watching lately？
Ah, I saw that too! Hey, let's watch it together next time.
I prefer books and movies over TV too... I think I get how you feel.
Hmm... There's a lot out there, huh？ Maybe I'll check it out too.
Hey, tell me what my best feature is？
Ah, I'm glad. But you know, you could compliment me even more？ Hehehe.
...Sorry, I couldn't hear you. Say it again？ Hehe.
Hehe, you're so shy.▼ I love that about you too.
What do you think of my hair right now？ Like it？
Hehe, good job. Here's a throat drop. Hehe.
Jeez, if that's what you thought, you should've said so. Right？
I don't mind changing to suit your tastes. So tell me anytime, okay？
Hey, what do you think of my outfit？ Is it your type？
Really？ ...I'm so glad. That's a relief. Hehe.
I see. Sorry, I'll put a bit more thought into it...
I'd love to pick out an outfit for you someday. Hehe.
I'll read a book while I wait, then. Let me know when you're done.
I see. Just make sure you don't overdo it, okay？
Something more important than me？ ...Hehe, kidding. Just wanted to tease you.▼
I wonder if you're the reason I haven't been sleeping well lately.
Oh, so you're aware？ Maybe I should get you back. Hehe.
Hmm, so you're not aware？ Go a little easy on me, okay？
It's just that my head is so full of you... I can't sleep.
Hey, we should go on another overnight trip, shouldn't we？
It was so fun, right？ ...We learned so much about each other. Hehe.
Aww, are you blushing？ Jeez, you're so cute.▼
Let's go again, just the two of us. And take our time.
Hey, am I being too clingy with you？
Good. I'm not gonna hold back from now on either, so you better be ready. Hehe.
I see... I guess I need to rethink things a bit, huh？
I just always want to feel your warmth... Would it bother you if I said that？
Hey, you were just thinking about me, weren't you？
Because I was thinking about you, too. Hehe, guess I hit the mark.▼
Hmm？ You're a bad liar. So cute.▼
My mind is always completely filled with you, though... Hehe!
▲主人公＊▲. Hey, what does happiness mean to you？
To me, happiness means you. Hehe.
Hehe, is that so？ Jeez, you're so cute.
For me, it's being able to spend time like this... Hehe.
Hey, this is what happiness feels like, isn't it？
▲主人公＊▲. Do you like me？ ...I love you. Hehe.
Hey. Don't you ever let me go, okay？
I feel so at ease when I'm with you...
Let's stay together, okay？ Forever and ever.
I just want to spend all day relaxing with you...
▲主人公＊▲. Come here, come here.▼*Smooch* Hehe!
Your big sister is feeling lonely... Did my notice-me beam work？ Hehe.
Hey, pat my head？ There, you did a great job. Hehe.
Oh, you've got something in your hair. I'll get it for you, so come here？ Hehe.
Hey, touch me？ Let's stay like this a little longer... Okay？
I'm getting a bit hungry... Maybe I'll whip up a little something.
...Ah, sorry. It's so warm and cozy, I just...
I kinda want to bask in the sun...
I wonder if it'll be hard to sleep tonight too.
It's gotten a lot greener out there, hasn't it？
The ginkgo trees were really pretty, you know？
The weather's gotten a lot more comfortable.
It's a great season for reading, isn't it？
Let's get a hot drink and warm up.
When it's this cold, it makes me wanna stay inside.
Hey, you haven't slept much, have you？ Are you okay？
You're up early... I'm still sleepy...
Mmm, it's still a bit early. Wanna go back to sleep？
Still sleepy？ I'll wake you up, so you can sleep more.
You have to eat a proper breakfast. Got it？
Morning. Were we lovey-dovey in your dreams too？ Hehe.
Come on, go wash your face and freshen up.
Are you sure you can take it this easy？ Hehe, jeez...
What are your plans today？ Me？ I'm up to you. Hehehe.
If we're going out, we need to get ready soon.
Alright, guess I'll do some chores. You just relax. Hehe.
Want something to drink？ Let's take a break.
I'm a little hungry. Want a piece of candy？
What should we have for lunch today... Hmm.
Now then, what should we eat for lunch...
Make sure you chew your food slowly and properly. Hehe.
Let's do our best this afternoon too.
Hey, you're a little sleepy, aren't you？ It shows.▼
If you want to take a nap, you can use my lap. Hehehe.
Snack time. Let's have something sweet.
Take a breather to boost your efficiency. Come here.▼
What should we have for dinner... Any requests？
If the sunset is pretty, it'll be sunny tomorrow.
I should start making dinner soon. Wanna help？ Hehe.
Treat me to a home-cooked meal sometime？ No rush. Hehe.
I wish I could make meals for you every day...
I want to take a nice, long soak in the tub today...
Alright, time to do the dishes. With you, ▼. Hehe.
Phew. Things have settled down a bit. Let's relax, okay？
Did you take a bath and get all squeaky clean？ Hehehe.
Hey, is there a movie on TV？ If there is, let's watch it together？
Are you all ready for tomorrow？ Make sure you do it before you get sleepy. Hehe.
I might be getting a little sleepy...
Did you brush your teeth properly？ If not, off you go, ▼.
Before bed, make sure to lock the doors and check the stove, okay？
Is it sleepy time？ Hehe, you're so cute, ▼.
If you're going to sleep, you have to give me a goodnight kiss first. Hehe.
If you can't sleep, let's chat. Hey, did anything good happen today？
Staying up so late... Will you be able to wake up on your own tomorrow？ Geez.
I'm sleepy. I don't want to get into bed all by myself... Are you still not going to sleep？
If you don't go to sleep soon, tomorrow's really going to be rough, you know？
I guess I have no choice but to keep you company. Shall we watch a movie or something？
Geez... You shouldn't stay up too late, okay？
You're up awfully early, aren't you？ Hehe, it's fine. I'll get up too.
How many times is that just today？ Do you really like me that much？ Hehe.
I'm really happy that you come to see me every day. Thank you.
Hey, are you going to keep staring at me？ Hehe.
You always come to see me around this time, right？ That's why I was waiting. Hehe.
We have so many memories together. Let's keep making more and more...
You haven't been seeing other girls lately... have you？ Not you. Right？
Hey, is it just me, or did it get wider？ Hehe, I think it's nice.
Do you like me enough that I show up in your dreams？ Hehe, me too. So make sure you do your best until the end, okay？
We're just one step away from reaching our goal. Let's do our best together, okay？
I told you no, didn't I？ Bad boys get... hehehe...
It looks like we can do all sorts of new things starting today. I'm looking forward to it.
See, we can do a lot more now, right？ I wanted to hear your thoughts. Well, is it fun？
Did you try out the new stuff？ Hehe, I'm just curious, that's all.
Hey... why haven't you been coming to see me lately？
...I'm mad. Because lately, you haven't been kissing me...
Do you think... you don't need me anymore？
I can't go on without you, though...
I don't want to be apart...
Are you trying to change the subject...？
Do you promise not to leave me alone again？
Then, pinky swear. If you lie, it's a thousand needles, okay？
Okay, I'll believe you. You can't leave me all alone anymore, got it？
Yeah, this looks cute... I think.
It doesn't look weird, does it？
Ah, wait... this one's nice too.
I need to check the horoscope rankings.
Looks like good things will happen today. Hehe.
Average, huh. Just a little more... Hmm.
I guess I'll just take it easy today...
His fortune is good. I should tell him when I see him.▼
Looks like he's got pretty good luck today. Yep, yep.
His is neither good nor bad... Just average.
His fortune is... Hmm, I'll keep it a secret. I'd feel bad if he got depressed over it...
Smells good. I'm sure he'll like it... Hehe.
Just a little more around here...
Want me to wash your back? ...Just kidding. Hehe.
Looks like I'll sleep soundly tonight too...
Maybe I'll go pick out the next bath salts with him...
Huh... Did I eat too much?
It really does tighten things up. Hehe.
Hmm, do I need to try a little harder?
Maybe I'll ask him what he prefers next time.
Is this a little too childish?
Is this one a bit too flashy...?
...Maybe I'll ask him what he likes soon? Hehehe.
I wonder what kind he likes?
I guess boys really do prefer them bigger...
Maybe I'll do some research and buy one he'd like...
Let's see, the recipe, the recipe...
I hope it turns out delicious.
He'll be happy with this, right？
Put all the cups... in the fridge...
If I go back to sleep, I won't be able... to get up...
My dream... I think he was in it...
Good morning... Huh？ Oh right, he's not here...
He could've at least given me a wake-up call...
What should I do for breakfast...
I wanna wake up to his voice...
Bad boys get punished, you know...？
Tell me you love me？ ...Good boy...
What was I... doing today again...
Maybe a shower will wake me up...
I won't get up unless... I get a good morning kiss...
Why is my bed... so comfy...
How was your year？ Tell your big sister？
Me？ We're together, but you don't know？ Hehe.
Ah, five minutes left. That went fast.
One minute left. Here we go？
30 seconds! You know what we do at the 10-second mark, right？
Let's do lots of things together this year too, okay？
Hm？ What do you want me to choose？
Then put the things you want me to pick on my left and right side？
Hmm, maybe I'll go with this one？
Okay, I pick this one. Hehe.
Was that a good way to choose？ Hehe.
It's just a suggestion, okay？ What matters is what you want.
My intuition is spot on, you know？ Hehe.
If you're ever unsure again, just ask me？ I'm always here.
What's wrong？ Did something bad happen？
I know how hard you're trying. So have some confidence, okay？
Even if I say not to worry, you still do, right？ I get it...
Let's believe things will turn out for the best？ Okay？
How's that？ Do you feel a little better？
Looking down just brings your mood down. Look up, okay？
I like it much better when you smile, you know？
Tears make your heart stronger. You don't have to hold them back just because you're a boy？
We have plenty of time, so take it slow, okay？
I think that just couldn't be helped...
Sometimes time is the only thing that can fix it... right？
I'm always right here with you. So you don't need to worry？
You're welcome. ...Mhm, there's the you I know？ I'm glad your big sister could help.
Don't keep everything bottled up, okay？ You can always tell me.
Hey, can I... lay next to you？ I thought I'd sleep beside you...
I'll stay right by your side so you can sleep peacefully？
Good work today. Get some rest.

Are you too nervous
to sleep？ Hehe.

Hehe, such a cute
sleeping face▼

Did you have a bad dream？
Are you okay now？

It's okay. I'll watch over
you until you fall asleep,
so don't worry, alright？

Was sleeping next to me
too much for you？ Hehe.

...Ah. You were so warm,
I just... Hehe, morning.

Stretching？ Maybe I'll keep
you company. Hehe.

Hey, keep me company？
I'm a bit out of shape,
so let's stretch. Okay？

Aw, that's a shame.
Next time, then？

Feet shoulder-width apart,
left hand on your hip.
Right arm up by your ear,
and stretch it out？

Like that. When I say
1, 2, 3, 4, you follow up
with 5, 6, 7, 8. Got it？

Hey. You can be louder
than that, right？

Come on, project your
voice from your stomach.

Next is the other side.
Ready？

Next, step forward, hands
on hips. Bend your right
knee, keep your left leg
straight, and stretch
your Achilles tendon.

Finally, feet shoulder-width
apart, bend forward and
touch your toes... then
stand up, hands on hips,
and lean back.

Okay, stretches are done.
Let's try to keep our bodies
moving as much as we can,
alright？
Hehe, you want to do some push-ups？
I haven't been getting enough exercise lately. Want to work out together？
Hey, I want to do some push-ups. Will you keep me company？
Hehe, you're so sweet. Let's get started, then.
I see. Well, maybe next time... We'll do it together then, okay？
One set is 10 push-ups. How many sets can you do？
That sounds like a good amount to start with, right？
Yeah, it's good to be able to do at least that much.
Let me know if it gets too tough, okay？ You can do it!
Hehe, you're such a boy. Alright, let's see what you've got.
Let's get started, then. Count out loud with me, okay？
I can't hear you, you know？
Hehe, ready for the next one？
I won't be mad if you need to tap out, you know.
Are you okay？ Don't push yourself too hard.
Keep it up, just a little more!
I know you can do it!
This is the last set, ready？
Wow... I think I'm falling for you all over again. Hehe.
Good work. It'd be great if you can keep this up.
Here, come closer. Let me wipe your sweat.
It feels pretty good when you can do this much, right？
Now I want to do it too. Hey, will you count for me？
I think I'm... at my limit...
Haa. Your big sister is all tired out... I must be out of shape. Hehehe.
Phew, good work. Let's exercise together again sometime.
Haa, I got all sweaty... Mind if I go take a shower？
Maybe we should take one together. Hehe, just kidding. See you in a bit？
What is it？ You want to do some sit-ups？ Hehe.
One set is 10 sit-ups. How many sets will you do？
Hehe, wanna play a game together？ Sure, let's play.
Hey, hey, play a game with me？
Hmm, so cold. Hehe, just kidding. Next time, okay？
Hehe, I'm not gonna let you win today.
Well then, maybe I should give you a handicap. Hehehe.
Now then, what should we do.
Hehe, I won't lose, you know？
If you aren't nice to girls, they'll end up hating you. Hehe.
Maybe I should go all out. Hehe.
Oh... you're quitting. Let's take it easy next time.
That was fun, wasn't it？ What do you think, wanna go another round？
Hehe, I'd expect no less. Alright, from the top again？
Mhm, you're right. We had plenty of fun today, after all.
Let's play again soon. Good work.
Did you have... a rough time？
No. It's okay, you don't have to say anything...
Look at me？ I need you to listen closely to what I'm about to say.
It might be a little long, but... is that okay？
Princes from all over the world come to propose to me. Traveling from everywhere.
Handsome princes, smart princes, incredibly sweet princes, so many of them. Got it？ Princes from all over the world, you know？
But you know what？ Even then, they can't compare to you.
You're the only one I want.
Hmm... maybe that was hard to understand... Then, for example...
What if I was offered a gorgeous house？
Super spacious, with a beautiful garden, a fancy kitchen, and even a cute little dog.
The kind of amazing house that makes everyone walking by jealous.
But you know, if you're not there, I wouldn't want it at all. I'd rather be by your side.
It means that I love you.
No matter what happens to you from now on, or what anyone says, I love you.
I have so many things I want to say, like 'do your best' or 'cheer up'...
But the only thing I really want you to remember is just that.
That I love you. And that I'm right here by your side.
If you ever feel like you hate everything again, always remember that.
